name: toro-holiday-ideas
description: TŌRO sub-plugin — the four-times-a-year sticky feature. Generates draft NZ school-holiday plans in 10 minutes instead of two evenings: OSCAR-approved programmes, sports camps, library activities, council free stuff, day-trip ideas with driving time + cost, rainy-day backups by suburb. Auto-fires at the start of each school holiday window (term-planner tells it when). Sources are NZ-specific and regularly refreshed.
